purpose: Visual review proposals, not production assets or runtime screenshots

prompts.a:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a new high-fidelity visual review storyboard for the existing Chinese couples app LoveGirl using the attached approved two-screen Polaroid concept as the visual reference, not as a literal collage. Landscape 3:2 board, exactly THREE tall front-on Android-style app screens in one row, large and readable, no phone hardware, no perspective tilt, no hands, no props. A tiny board title outside screens says "01 · 拍立得：浏览、翻面、手绘" and "视觉方案 · 非运行截图". Preserve the reference's large textured photographic prints, substantial paper thickness, recessed photo aperture, fine paper fibers, gently irregular edge and realistic soft cast shadow on cool pale-gray surfaces. More physical material detail without clutter. Interface chrome is neutral cool-white, crisp black Chinese sans serif text, quiet frosted glass tool panels with restrained refraction and strong text contrast; main CTA opaque black. Avoid orange brand chrome, floating dashboard cards, gradients as branding, emoji and childish stickers.

Screen 1: "拍立得", month selector "2026年10月". A huge portrait instant print dominates, with adjacent prints just peeking at left/right to imply horizontal paging, retaining the approved concept's composition. Use a natural editorial PHOTO of the same adult East Asian couple from the reference by the sea, not illustration or synthetic 3D people. A black handwritten ink caption on the lower paper border says exactly "海边，和你", small date "2026.10.24", an explicit flip icon on paper lower right, counter "07 / 12", black bottom CTA "制作拍立得". Photo roughly 65 percent of screen height, ample but purposeful breathing room.

Screen 2: "照片背面". Show the reverse side of the SAME paper print enlarged, neutral off-white fiber paper with very faint ruled lines and subtle edge thickness, no photo image on the back. Readable handwritten memory note exactly "那天海风很大，我们却走得很慢。" with date "2026.10.24". Small travel chip "青岛两日". Two small restrained actions "编辑记录" and "翻回正面", modest shared-state label "两个人可见". No social feed, no chat.

Screen 3: "制作拍立得", small "存草稿" action top right. Same large PHOTO print. The lower white paper margin is the active drawing surface: the caption "海边，和你" and a tiny imperfect drawn heart are visibly real freehand BLACK INK strokes, with part of the baseline underlined by a drawn pen, not a text field or decorative handwriting font sample. A restrained translucent glass bottom tool panel has tabs "相纸", "成像", "涂鸦", "背面", with "涂鸦" selected as black capsule. Pen, eraser, undo, redo icons, a thin stroke-width slider and four small ink swatches; no giant color palette. Opaque black CTA "完成并收藏". Don't overlay controls on the writing or photo. Keep the entire image polished, practical, and believable as Flutter implementable UI. All Chinese text readable, short and precisely spelled. Do not include anything from camera brands. This is static design review only.
prompts.b:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a matching companion storyboard to the attached approved LoveGirl Polaroid concept. Landscape 3:2 board, exactly THREE tall front-on app screens in one row, equal size and spacing, no physical device frame, no hands, no desk props, crisp legible Chinese typography. Tiny external title "02 · 拍立得：相机、相纸、成像" plus "视觉方案 · 非运行截图". Neutral cool-white/pale-gray interface, physical paper texture, subtle Apple-like frosted glass tool surfaces, black main action buttons, generous photo space. Use realistic editorial photography, including the same adult East Asian couple by the sea as the reference. Do not add orange UI branding, rainbow interface gradients, purchasable badges or PRO locks. Every asset is an original design rather than a camera brand logo.

Screen 1 "相机": an original restrained vintage CCD-inspired camera interface with a large live-view photograph filling the upper 60 percent, monochrome flash/timer/switch-camera icons along a slim top strip. Below, a compact brushed-silver and black camera control area with a visibly tactile circular metal shutter, a photo-import thumbnail to its left, simple camera-switch icon to its right. Small selected look label "CCD 01". Do not let a large decorative camera body overwhelm the photo. Small text "拍摄" and "导入照片" where useful, no video recording controls, no 3D or multiple exposure features.

Screen 2 "选择相纸": show a scrollable 2-column gallery of SIX distinct full-size representative instant-paper thumbnails with natural photographs, and an understated count "20 款". The six shown materially differ: classic fiber white, charcoal black, woven cotton white with real fabric-like grain, asymmetric muted-blue edge, torn-edge peel-apart print, and a neutral silver-foil edge. They are different paper structures and apertures rather than colored copies of one rectangle. Short captions "经典白", "炭黑", "织纹", "雾蓝", "撕拉", "银箔". One selected item has a simple thin black border and check mark. Bottom CTA "使用这款相纸". Maintain physical thickness and recessed image wells on the small previews.

Screen 3 "选择成像": show the same large paper-framed couple photograph above a restrained glass selector panel. The panel title "12 款成像", a simple category row "即时", "CCD", "胶片", "黑白", current "CCD" black capsule. Three horizontally scrollable preview thumbnails of THE SAME photo with visibly distinct but credible color/texture rendering, short labels "CCD 01", "CCD 02", "CCD 03", selected first. No swiping color wheel or large rainbow palette. A small "强度" slider, button "应用成像", secondary "存草稿". Fidelity is important: legible labels, practical hit areas, the same visual language as the reference and a quiet, non-AI-template feel. Avoid made-up metrics, social content or extra features.
prompts.c:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity THREE-SCREEN Chinese LoveGirl ticket-making storyboard. Input 1 is the actually observed ticket editor STRUCTURAL reference: large external canvas, landscape ticket with photo at left, narrow typographic stub at right, perforated divider, edge notch, shadow. Input 2 is the approved Polaroid concept STYLE reference: cool neutral surfaces, restrained frosted panels and black CTAs. Create a new coherent interface, not a collage of the screenshots. Landscape 3:2 board, THREE equal tall front-on app screens in one row, no hardware frames, no angled phones. External small heading "03 · 票根：选模板、编辑、收藏" and "视觉方案 · 非运行截图".

Screen 1 "旅行票根": a 2-column gallery with six visible template previews and count "8 款模板". Use realistic original Shanghai urban riverfront/architecture photos, NOT the blue mug photo or an embedded Bebo paper frame from the structural reference. Visible template compositions: horizontal landscape stub, vertical commemorative ticket, clean city postcard, slim multi-photo filmstrip, a two-photo couples ticket, and a simple date-led ticket. Each visually differs in layout and paper detail. Labels "横向纪念", "竖向票根", "城市明信片", "胶片长票", "双人拼图", "日期纪念". Restrained cool-gray, ink-black, muted blue paper accents; no rainbow UI or purple app branding. One selection marked black.

Screen 2 "制作票根": top left close, top right "存草稿". Center a large ticket on a cool light-gray canvas, photo area full-bleed at left, right stub colored muted blue-gray. Precisely readable title "上海，和你", date "2026.10.24", small decorative serial "LG-1024", barcode lines, semicircular right-edge notch, vertical perforation, subtle paper grain and cast shadow. The title is selected with a simple thin outline to indicate editable TEXT, no arbitrary layer handles or free-layout studio. Bottom editing panel with tabs "照片", "文字", "配色", "背景"; active "文字". Two clean fields "标题" with "上海，和你", and "日期" with "2026.10.24". Bottom opaque black CTA "完成并收藏". Content readability above decoration.

Screen 3 "票根详情": same completed ticket shown large with NO selection frame or editor controls inside the artwork. Below are concise chips "两个人可见" and "上海两日", a small section "我们的记录" and one line "第一次一起看外滩的夜景。". Two distinct actions "继续编辑" and black "导出图片". The saved artwork is shared, but no shared live draft or new group/social system. A quiet saved check "已收藏". Original visual design, restrained liquid-glass chrome, realistic printed-paper material, consistent with the style reference. Do not copy third-party logos, PRO badges, dates from the old screenshot, or technical EXIF/implementation copy into the user flow.
prompts.d:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity Chinese LoveGirl travel map storyboard using input 1 as the STRUCTURAL reference for the actually observed Pi Travel map, pale street map, numbered route stops, bottom horizontal place card and pull-up daily itinerary. Input 2 is the LoveGirl STYLE reference for neutral typography and restrained frosted control surfaces. Landscape 3:2 board, exactly THREE equal portrait app screens in one row, front-on, no hardware frames or angled phone mockups. External title "04 · 旅行：地图、逐日行程、交通" and "视觉方案 · 非运行截图". This must closely reflect the reference's useful layout rather than turning it into a generic dashboard. White/light-gray chrome, readable black hierarchy, cyan route highlight only, softly rounded lower sheet, neutral monochrome action icons. No emoji, no AI button, no advertisement, no chat, no orange brand UI.

Screen 1: map-dominant travel page. Header "上海两日" with a small chevron to switch trip and a subtle two-person icon. Large pale actual-looking Shanghai street map, Huangpu River at east, unobtrusive roads, one bright cyan routed path with directional arrow ticks between "豫园" numbered 1 at the east and "武康大楼" numbered 2 to the west. Selected stop 2 is black with white numeral; other stop cyan. Map controls above panel: "周边" off on left, recenter and fit-route icons on right. White bottom sheet occupies lower third, with grab handle, tabs "总览", "10.24", "10.25", "待计划"; cyan underline under "10.24". A large horizontally swipeable place card with a realistic Wukang Mansion photograph, title "武康大楼", short category "历史建筑". A concise route summary below. Keep the map the main area and match the reference proportions.

Screen 2: expanded DAILY itinerary panel fills most of screen, only a map strip remains above. Header "10.24 周六", tab row same as screen 1. Two numbered place rows with real thumbnail photos and names "1. 豫园", "2. 武康大楼". Between them a distinct transport row "步行 · 6.2公里 · 约1小时22分". Small "备注" action under each stop, grab handles at right to imply long-press reorder. A second day section "10.25 周日" with "外滩", followed by "待计划". Bottom action bar "添加地点", "移动至", "删除", with selected-state check on one stop. Show practical daily grouping, not decorative cards stacked without logic. No auto hotel claim for non-hotel places.

Screen 3: a clear white bottom-sheet "交通方式" over a dimmed pale map, origin "豫园" destination "武康大楼". Four readable rows with simple outlined icons: "步行", "骑行", "驾车", "公共交通". Show short example distance/time descriptions consistent with a design sample, no taxi prices. Walking selected with thin black outline and check. Bottom black CTA "采用步行"; secondary "打开地图导航". All fields clear and readable, route cyan restrained, no special effects blocking map labels. Include an unobtrusive two-person shared indicator, not an invitation flow. The board is a visual proposal, not a geographic/navigation data guarantee. Match structural reference closely while keeping LoveGirl text and original imagery.
